name: Ichabod
bio: Ichabod was the son of Phinehas, son of Eli. When Israel went to war against the Philistines and the ark was captured, both Hophni and Phinehas were killed, and their father Eli, hearing the news, fell over and died of shock. Phinehas's wife was pregnant and near delivery; when she heard that the ark had been captured and that her father-in-law and husband were dead, the shock sent her into labor. As she was dying in childbirth, the women attending her told her she had given birth to a son, but she did not respond, only saying, "The glory has departed from Israel" — and so she named the boy Ichabod, meaning "no glory," repeating again, "The glory has departed from Israel, for the ark of God has been captured, and my father-in-law and my husband are dead" (1 Samuel 4:19-22). The name Ichabod became one of the most symbolically weighted names in Israel's history, forever marking the day the ark was lost and Eli's household collapsed.
